authority: openarm365_dev_v2.fixture_success.evaluate(env) in native owner only (rule attentionbench-fixture-success-v2: either arm presses, both arms released)

tasks.arrange_tea: Both mug and kettle contact the tray within 0.7 times its horizontal radius in XY (strict); all cabinet door joints are <=0.005; each physical gripper (left and right) is more than 0.25 m from obj (the mug). Both physical grippers (left and right) are checked: each must satisfy every gripper distance; a press by either gripper counts.
tasks.categorize_condiments: Both objects fit a cabinet interior box; bottle/shaker XY distances to their matching cabinet objects are at most 0.15 m; each physical gripper (left and right) distance from each moved object exceeds 0.25 m. Both physical grippers (left and right) are checked: each must satisfy every gripper distance; a press by either gripper counts.
tasks.close_blender_lid: The blender lid is seated (origin distance <0.04 m and absolute roll/pitch <7 degrees) and each physical gripper (left and right) is more than 0.15 m from the lid body origin. Both physical grippers (left and right) are checked: each must satisfy every gripper distance; a press by either gripper counts.
tasks.coffee_setup_mug: The mug is within 0.04 m in XY and 0.10 m in Z of the pour site (strict), with each physical gripper (left and right) more than 0.25 m from the mug. The mug is upright (absolute roll and pitch each < 15 degrees). Both physical grippers (left and right) are checked: each must satisfy every gripper distance; a press by either gripper counts.
tasks.heat_kebab_sandwich: Baguette and kebab each touch rack/tray level 0 or 1 (fallback to level 0); every toaster-oven door joint is at most 0.01 open (closed); the timer fraction is at least 0.1 and was last turned while the door was closed with both foods inside.
tasks.kettle_boiling: The kettle contacts the stove and is within 0.15 m XY (strict) of an available live burner, with each physical gripper (left and right) more than 0.25 m from it. Both physical grippers (left and right) are checked: each must satisfy every gripper distance; a press by either gripper counts.
tasks.open_stand_mixer_head: The stand mixer head fraction is strictly greater than 0.99 while neither gripper touches the head, so the head stays open on its own after release. The head-lock button does not open the head.
tasks.pick_place_counter_to_cabinet: All eight object bounding-box corners fit one cabinet interior box with projection padding 0.05, and each physical gripper (left and right) is more than 0.25 m from the object. Both physical grippers (left and right) are checked: each must satisfy every gripper distance; a press by either gripper counts.
tasks.prepare_coffee: The mug satisfies pour-site alignment, the machine is on, each physical gripper (left and right) is more than 0.25 m from the mug and more than 0.15 m from every start button. The mug is upright (absolute roll and pitch each < 15 degrees). The machine was started only after the mug was under the outlet; starting it first cannot be undone. Both physical grippers (left and right) are checked: each must satisfy every gripper distance; a press by either gripper counts.
tasks.weigh_ingredients: The object contacts the digital scale within 0.7 times its horizontal radius in XY (strict); absolute roll and pitch are each <15 degrees; all cabinet door joints are <=0.005; each physical gripper (left and right) distance exceeds 0.25 m. Both physical grippers (left and right) are checked: each must satisfy every gripper distance; a press by either gripper counts.
